message: I find it utterly amusing that a "champion of the common man" such as yourself would resort to name-dropping in such an eloquent testimonial.  The fact that you would readily admit that you own a "Weber" removes all street-cred that you may have once had.  In its place now rests a sort of corporate-cred that will insure your spot in society as an elitist pig.  Next time you should use the standard term "grill" in its place just to be safe, socioeconomically speaking.  HA!  I wonder what grilled "Spring Rings" would taste like.
